scope: Every finding of docs/audit/REPO-STATE-20261110/REPORT.md (F-01..F-16) plus findings raised during remediation (N-xx).
rule: A finding is FIXED only when the defect itself is corrected and verified; documenting it is DOCUMENTED.

findings.title: No document states that main is stale, that checkpoint/wave16 is the latest unified line, or what the unmerged stacks are
findings.original_evidence: Search of *.md for 'wave16' found nothing on main, wave16 or the D13/sky-mob/sky-tower tips; one ST-01 doc names it as its own base only.
findings.current_evidence: Recomputed 2026-11-10 from commit ancestry: main cde842dd (last PR merge 2026-10-22) is 335 commits behind checkpoint/wave16-unified-20261104 65072bca; the computed index lists 7 stack roots on wave16 (D13, ST-01, sky-tower, sky-mob, ST-03 and two single-branch docs); 27 merged PRs' work is not in main.
findings.practical_impact: An agent or reviewer reading main or any single branch gets a wrong picture of the project state.
findings.required_remediation: Provide a generated, dated, machine-readable current-state index and keep the audit report; baseline selection is the owner's.
findings.verification_evidence: docs/CURRENT_STATE.json generated by `drive_mirror current-state`; byte-reproducible from identical inputs (test_lineage_and_current_state_are_reproducible, OK). The index states integrated_project_state = NOT ESTABLISHED.
findings.residual: The integration baseline itself is an owner decision; no document on any protected branch was changed.

findings.title: main's authority indexes are 2026-10-22; STRUCTURE_AUTHORITY_INDEX.md does not exist on main
findings.original_evidence: git diff --stat main checkpoint/wave16 -- docs: 447 files.
findings.current_evidence: Unchanged: main is still cde842dd; AGENTS.md routes agents on main to an index that predates accessory, bounty, ST-05, structure-index and later routing.
findings.practical_impact: Agents resolve authority from stale routing if they start on main.
findings.required_remediation: Owner decides whether main is updated from the checkpoint (D-1) and whether the prepared corrections are applied (D-7). Modifying main is forbidden here.
findings.verification_evidence: Not modifiable under AGENTS.md section 3 and this task's constraints; current-state index warns readers.

findings.title: Research node counts: index says 45/40/2, audit table says 43/42/2
findings.original_evidence: Index 'now records 45 DATA_ONLY, 40 PARTIAL and 2 BLOCKED'; audit totals table 43/42/2.
findings.current_evidence: Independent recount of the 87-row node table at wave16: 43 DATA_ONLY + 42 PARTIAL + 2 BLOCKED = 87 (87 unique ids), equal to the audit's totals table. The index sentence is a 2026-10-17 record (document blob 22ba8747 on design/stage23a-remaining-approval-20261017 has exactly 45/40/2): history, not a live conflict. No descendant of wave16 touches research source or docs, so 43/42/2 is current. 31/42 PARTIAL rows cite an existing non-catalog Java class; 11 cite vanilla/mixin methods and were not mechanically checkable.
findings.practical_impact: Misleading status for research implementation progress.
findings.required_remediation: Annotate the index sentence as historical and point at the current count.
findings.verification_evidence: Row recount script output (87 rows / 87 unique ids / 43-42-2); patches/docs/0002 prepared (applies on all 7 tips tested). Sub-item UNVERIFIED: behaviour of 11 PARTIAL rows.
findings.residual: Behaviour-level claims for the 11 rows remain UNVERIFIED (U-RES).

findings.title: Royal chest implemented twice (PR #245 D13-03 stack vs PR #254 ST-01 stack)
findings.original_evidence: Trial merge of 6c7923e0 and 03685656: 8 conflicted files.
findings.current_evidence: Re-run on current tips: same 8 files (6 add/add + 2 content), merge-base = wave16. Side B is a superset in the persistence layer; each side carries authority documents the other lacks. Full analysis, strategies and required verification: CURRENT_STATE facts C-1.
findings.practical_impact: The two stacks cannot both be merged; the reward-system semantics differ by authority source.
findings.required_remediation: Owner chooses the governing authority and integration strategy; then reconcile once and run the listed verification.
findings.verification_evidence: git merge-tree --write-tree reproduced (exit 1, 8 paths); royal_chest_conflict.json in evidence/.

findings.title: CI repairs (#240, #242) merged only into sibling stacks; ST-01 stack fails the same GameTest
findings.current_evidence: 15 current branch heads fail Fabric CI on colosseum_game_tests_absence_grace_resumes_on_return_and_expires_otherwise (log-extracted; 2 other failing heads fail different tests). All 11 wave16 descendants containing #240 or #242 pass; 15 without either fail; 7 without either pass (final snapshot). #242 contains the same two Colosseum commits as #240 plus a Tomb Guardian test alignment. #240/#242 are merged into their stacks' base branches only: neither is in main or wave16.
findings.practical_impact: ST-01 and D13 heads cannot reach green CI; masks real regressions.
findings.required_remediation: Apply the existing two-commit fix to the affected stacks (technical, behaviour-preserving). Prepared as a branch; not applied to any existing branch.
findings.verification_evidence: Branch remediation/st01-colosseum-clock-seam-20261110 (f2c0a6c8) = work/st01-p8c2a-complete-assembly-20261110-r1 (c25f9d44) + the two #240 commits; 6 files, all under colosseum/. Local, JDK 25.0.5, Gradle 9.6: `./gradlew test compileGametestJava` BUILD SUCCESSFUL, 594 JUnit tests / 0 failures (incl. 2 new ArenaControllerClockTest); `runGameTest` on a fresh worktree: all 551 required tests passed. Clean control (fresh worktree, unmodified c25f9d44): 1 required test failed = the absence-grace test, 'grace running on tick 49', identical to CI. n=1 each; causation supported by this before/after plus the CI cross-tabulation. See evidence/colosseum_gametest_verification.md.
findings.residual: A first control run reused a worktree and was contaminated by stale saved-world state (18 spurious failures); it is excluded from the evidence and replaced by the clean control.

findings.title: Shallow clone mis-reports branch relationships
findings.current_evidence: The audit tooling builds its own bare cache from a full fetch and never uses the working clone for ancestry; lineage was computed on that cache.
findings.practical_impact: Wrong lineage numbers if computed in a shallow clone.
findings.required_remediation: Always compute ancestry from the full cache.
findings.verification_evidence: `git --git-dir=<cache> rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` = false (cache created by git init --bare + full fetch); lineage reproduced twice with identical bytes.

findings.title: PR-only refs were outside the default mirror scope
findings.current_evidence: 50 PR heads (48 closed, 2 merged) are in no branch (49,080 files, 0.82 GB logical, 223 new blobs / 4.8 MB, ~57k Drive items).
findings.practical_impact: Closed-PR work reachable only through refs/pull/* would not be on Drive.
findings.required_remediation: Default to orphaned; namespaces under pulls/, separate from branches/.
findings.verification_evidence: test_pr_only_refs_are_in_default_scope_with_exact_manifests_and_isolated_namespaces; full repository emulator run (MIRROR_COMPLETENESS.md).

findings.title: A mirrored PR snapshot would be retired when a branch later contains its commit
findings.current_evidence: Reproduced in design review: under orphaned scope the ref leaves the desired set and _retire_missing moved the namespace.
findings.practical_impact: Silent loss of a PR snapshot from the active mirror.
findings.required_remediation: Keep a mirrored PR namespace while the remote still advertises the ref.
findings.verification_evidence: test_pr_namespace_is_sticky_when_a_branch_later_contains_the_head.

findings.title: Deletion confirmation could not distinguish a missing ref from an inaccessible one
findings.current_evidence: Two full listings are not independent evidence of deletion.
findings.practical_impact: A hidden/denied/truncated listing could retire live namespaces.
findings.required_remediation: Require a targeted successful ls-remote that finds nothing, and (for PR heads) the GitHub API; otherwise keep, mark unconfirmed, report.
findings.verification_evidence: test_pr_ref_disappearance_distinguishes_inaccessible_from_deleted, test_branch_probe_failure_is_inaccessible_not_deleted; mass-retire guard re-tested (test_mass_retire_guard_and_dry_run).

findings.title: Serial Drive folder walks would take hours against real Drive; per-run full verify infeasible
findings.current_evidence: ~32,000 namespace folders (+7,800 for PR-only) walked one request at a time.
findings.practical_impact: Hourly runs could exceed the 6 h job limit.
findings.required_remediation: Parallel crawl; incremental runs verify bytes only for changed namespaces; reconcile verifies in full.
findings.verification_evidence: test_scoped_verify_reads_far_less_and_full_verify_still_catches_drift; whole-repo emulator timings.

findings.title: A cron-selected daily reconcile can be starved by Actions concurrency
findings.current_evidence: A newer pending run replaces an older pending one in the same group.
findings.practical_impact: Drift repair might never run on a busy mirror.
findings.required_remediation: Decide reconcile from persisted last_reconcile_at; one hourly cron.
findings.verification_evidence: test_incremental_run_upgrades_itself_to_reconcile_from_persisted_state.

findings.verification_evidence: actionlint clean; all 4 third-party actions pinned to 40-hex SHAs (checked by script).

findings.title: No pre-upload secret gate

findings.title: Resumable upload retry mishandled 409 fileIdInUse
findings.original_classification: NEW (latent defect, found by a flaky regression)
findings.current_evidence: Lost response on the final PUT of a >5 MB upload, retried with the same generated id.
findings.practical_impact: Large-file sync could fail and need a rerun.
findings.required_remediation: Treat 409/fileIdInUse on the PUT as already created.
findings.verification_evidence: test_lost_response_on_resumable_put_does_not_duplicate_or_fail (deterministic); test_transient_errors_and_rate_limits_are_retried.

findings.title: Full Git history is not mirrored

findings.practical_impact: Gemini sees tip states, not what changed when.
findings.required_remediation: Approve and add a history archive (bundle and/or commit-graph metadata) as a separate extension.
findings.verification_evidence: MIRROR_COMPLETENESS.md section 3 (measured).

findings.title: Remote moved during the audit
findings.current_evidence: Between the first audit snapshot (02:51 UTC) and the final snapshot of this work (11:33 UTC): 126 -> 135 branches (this audit's branch, its remediation branch and 7 others), 252 -> 259 PRs, 289 -> 301 PR refs, 4 existing heads advanced. New ST-01 heads (p8c2a, g0-*, phase4-worldgen) also fail the grace test.
findings.practical_impact: Any SHA in this register is a point-in-time value.
